name: turn_flash
vid_walk_side_noref
prompt:
Realistic full-body video of a man walking at a normal relaxed walking pace from the left side of the frame toward the right, as a walk-cycle animation reference for a video game: natural heel-to-toe steps, opposite arm swings with each step, upright posture, steady constant speed, at least four full steps.

The man: an Iranian man around 40, lean build, short dark hair, full dark beard, wearing the same dark charcoal suit jacket, dark shirt, dark trousers and black leather shoes. Do not change his identity or clothing at any moment of the video.

Camera: exact side view (90 degrees profile), camera at hip height, tracking sideways on a dolly at exactly his walking speed so he stays centered in the frame the whole time, whole body from head to shoes always visible, no zoom, no cuts.

Setting: empty seamless light-grey photo studio (cyclorama), flat uniform background, plain floor of the same grey, soft even diffuse lighting, no props, no other people, no text, no logos, no music video effects. Photorealistic, natural real motion, 24 fps look, sharp focus, no motion blur trails, no cuts, one continuous shot.
